Container.Name: FluxMQ-Dashboard
Container.Overview:
Web dashboard for a FluxMQ broker (install the FluxMQ template first): live message and traffic charts, connected and offline sessions, subscriptions and broker info. It only reads; nothing can be changed from it.
Set FluxMQ admin API to the broker's admin API, for example http://192.168.1.10:8082. Alternatively set Network Type to Container: FluxMQ and use http://127.0.0.1:8082; the dashboard is then reached on the broker's IP, port 3001, and has to be restarted after FluxMQ is restarted or updated.
The dashboard has no login. Keep it on your LAN.

Config.Name: FluxMQ admin API
Config.Description: URL of the FluxMQ admin API, for example http://192.168.1.10:8082 (the server's IP and the host port of FluxMQ's Admin API). With Network Type Container: FluxMQ use http://127.0.0.1:8082.

Config.Name: Cluster node URLs
Config.Description: Only for a FluxMQ cluster: comma-separated admin API URLs of all nodes. Empty = the admin API above.
